cards.example_en: A big dog waited outside the bakery for its owner.
cards.example_zh: 一只大狗在面包店外面等它的主人。

cards.example_en: His new bike has a bright red basket.
cards.example_zh: 他的新自行车上装着一个鲜红的车筐。

cards.example_en: Dad paid the electricity bill at the bank.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸在银行付了电费帐单。

cards.example_en: Throw the empty bottle into the recycling bin.
cards.example_zh: 把空瓶子扔进回收垃圾桶。

cards.example_en: Our biology teacher brought a model of the heart.
cards.example_zh: 我们的生物学老师带来了一个心脏模型。

cards.example_en: A small bird built a nest outside the classroom.
cards.example_zh: 一只小鸟在教室外面筑了巢。

cards.example_en: The baby's birth brought joy to the whole family.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝的出生给全家带来了喜悦。

cards.example_en: We baked a cake for Mum's birthday on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 星期六我们为妈妈的生日烤了一个蛋糕。

cards.example_en: He dipped a biscuit into his warm milk.
cards.example_zh: 他把饼干蘸进了温热的牛奶里。

cards.example_en: Add a bit of salt to the soup, please.
cards.example_zh: 请往汤里加一点点盐。

cards.example_en: A black umbrella kept both of us dry in the storm.
cards.example_zh: 一把黑伞让我们俩在暴风雨里没被淋湿。

cards.example_en: The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.
cards.example_zh: 老师把日期写在了黑板上。

cards.example_en: His knee began to bleed after he fell on the playground.
cards.example_zh: 他在操场上摔倒后，膝盖开始流血。

cards.example_en: The blind passenger asked where the next stop was.
cards.example_zh: 那位失明的乘客问下一站在哪里。

cards.example_en: The library is one block from our school gate.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆离我们学校大门只有一个街区。

cards.example_en: The nurse took a sample of my blood.
cards.example_zh: 护士抽了一点我的血做样本。

cards.example_en: She wore a blue blouse to the concert.
cards.example_zh: 她穿了一件蓝衬衫去听音乐会。

cards.example_en: Strong winds blow the leaves across our front yard.
cards.example_zh: 大风把落叶吹过我们家的前院。

cards.example_en: Her blue scarf blew off while she waited for the bus.
cards.example_zh: 她等公交时，蓝围巾被风吹走了。

cards.example_en: Pin the notice on the board outside the office.
cards.example_zh: 把通知钉在办公室外面的板子上。

cards.example_en: We rowed a small boat across the calm lake.
cards.example_zh: 我们划着小船穿过了平静的湖面。

cards.example_en: Exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
cards.example_zh: 锻炼能让你的身体保持强壮和健康。

cards.example_en: Boil the eggs for eight minutes before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭前把鸡蛋煮八分钟。

cards.example_en: I finished the book under the lamp last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚我在灯下把那本书读完了。

cards.example_en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我睡着了。

cards.example_en: My cousin was born in a small seaside town.
cards.example_zh: 我表弟出生在一个海滨小镇。

cards.example_en: May I borrow your ruler for this drawing exercise?
cards.example_zh: 这道绘画练习我可以借你的尺子吗？

cards.example_en: Her boss praised the team for finishing early.
cards.example_zh: 她的老板表扬了提前完成工作的团队。

cards.example_en: Both of my parents are teachers.
cards.example_zh: 我的父母都是老师。

cards.example_en: I filled a bottle with cold water for the match.
cards.example_zh: 我灌了一瓶冷水，准备比赛时喝。

cards.example_en: Seaweed stuck to the bottom of the old boat.
cards.example_zh: 海草粘在那艘旧船的底面上。

cards.example_en: He ate noodles from a blue bowl at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭时他用一只蓝碗吃面条。

cards.example_en: I packed the gift in a small box.
cards.example_zh: 我把礼物装进了一个小盒子里。

cards.example_en: The boy shared his umbrella with a classmate.
cards.example_zh: 那个男孩和同学合打一把伞。

cards.example_en: A good sleep helps the brain stay sharp for exams.
cards.example_zh: 睡个好觉能让大脑在考试时保持清醒。

cards.example_en: A brave firefighter carried the child out of the smoke.
cards.example_zh: 一位勇敢的消防员把孩子从烟雾中抱了出来。

cards.example_en: Mum bought fresh bread from the corner shop.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈从街角的小店买了新鲜面包。

cards.example_en: Don't break the glass when you wash the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 洗碗时别把玻璃杯打破。

cards.example_en: I ate eggs and milk for breakfast today.
cards.example_zh: 我今天早餐吃了鸡蛋，喝了牛奶。

cards.example_en: She held her breath before jumping into the pool.
cards.example_zh: 跳进泳池之前，她屏住了呼吸。

cards.example_en: Walk across the bridge and turn left.
cards.example_zh: 走过桥，然后左转。

cards.example_en: Bright lamps over the desk help my eyes during homework.
cards.example_zh: 书桌上方的明亮台灯让我写作业时眼睛更舒服。

cards.example_en: Please bring your lunch to the picnic by the lake.
cards.example_zh: 去湖边野餐时，请带上你的午餐。

cards.example_en: My younger brother feeds the cat every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我弟弟每天早上给猫喂食。

cards.example_en: Brown shoes got muddy on the way across the wet field.
cards.example_zh: 棕色的鞋子在穿过湿地时沾上了泥。

cards.example_en: I brush my teeth every night.
cards.example_zh: 我每天晚上刷牙。

cards.example_en: We are working on a tight budget.
cards.example_zh: 我们的预算很紧。

cards.example_en: We will build a small bookshelf for my bedroom.
cards.example_zh: 我们要为我的卧室做一个小书架。

cards.example_en: The new building beside the library has six floors.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆旁边的新建筑物有六层楼。

cards.example_en: Students should never bully a classmate.
cards.example_zh: 学生绝不应该欺凌同学。

word.example_en: I go to the shop by bike.
The panda was tiny at birth.
The cat may give birth to three kittens.
word.example_zh: 这只猫可能会生下三只小猫。

word.example_en: I feel a bit tired after the game.
Add a bit of salt to the soup.
All the passengers are on board.
Both my sister and I like noodles.
Let us take a break and drink some water.
